preconditions.description: newun variable must be set to address(0) (uninitialized)
Attacker must have some token balance or be approved to transfer tokens from another account

exploit_hint: When newun is address(0), call transferFrom() with any non-zero 'from' address and set 'to' to your desired address. This will permanently set newun to your address, blocking all future transfers to that address. The owner must then call transfernewun() to change it back.
